rationale: Price is at 90.8% of today's range after a 10.5% gap-up on strong earnings news, sitting just $0.09 below the session high with the last five 1-minute candles showing a clear deceleration and rollover (from 16.64 down to 16.55) on declining but still elevated volume — momentum is fading near the high.
